benchmark.family_definition: one independently generated source-program skeleton with one allocated typed input; no source program or canonical skeleton appears in more than one family
benchmark.name: prospective deterministic program-execution instrument
benchmark.response_task: predict the exact typed output of a terminating deterministic Python program

allowed: bounded integers, booleans, strings, lists, tuples, and dictionaries
if/else, bounded for/while, and nested control flow
pure helper functions and prospectively depth-bounded recursion
execution_safety.sandbox: isolated subprocess/container with no network, read-only empty filesystem, seccomp/resource limits, deterministic locale/hash seed
execution_safety.verification: restricted-AST interpreter and sandboxed pinned CPython must agree exactly twice

freshness_and_diversity.behavioral_signature: private generator-only execution signatures on multiple nonallocated probe inputs
near_duplicate_checks: canonical AST identity and tree-edit threshold
freshness_and_diversity.near_duplicate_rate_gate: <= 1% within split and 0 exact canonical-skeleton matches across splits

inference.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% studentized family-level paired-mean t interval
inference.primary_test: one-sided studentized paired-family mean t test
inference.seed_regime: independent frozen policy seeds; exact same-policy router/champion selections share one generation and contribute zero
inference.simulation_basis: calibrated for independent seeds at N>=800; selected N=1000/R=2 gives 0.823 power for +0.03 under the conservative combined scenario

license: generator, generated programs, metadata, evaluator, and manifests to receive a prospectively selected permissive release license after legal/repository review
parser: condition-symmetric unique typed FINAL-literal parser; no fuzzy or semantic judge; exact typed comparison

primary_system.comparison: frozen one-call routed A0 K=8 portfolio versus frozen V4_DIRECTION_02_MEDIUM champion
primary_system.router_training_population: original closed 300 CRUXEval development families only

stop_rule: qualification failure closes or prospectively redesigns the instrument; no cherry-picking and no reuse of qualification families
